profile_text.body:
Janitor AI operates a platform, which it describes as a space for creators building immersive worlds and readers seeking living stories, positioning itself at the intersection of human creativity and AI. The site presents the platform under the name "janitor" and emphasizes the ability to build, share, and explore AI-driven narrative and character experiences.

The company's primary product, tracked under the Chat and General LLMs category, is Janitor AI, a persona-based chat platform available at janitorai.com. Given its focus on character roleplay and immersive storytelling, the platform carries noted considerations around appropriate use and HR-related risk. No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations are associated with the company in the held facts.
